english.title: Park / drive or cause parking / driving of vehicle on Midland Metro so as to obstruct a vehicle / person on the Metro
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[parked a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[drove a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(C)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be parked]_
(D)_[caused a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), to be driven]_

on part of the Midland Metro Light Rapid Transit System at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..) in such a position or manner as was likely to or as did cause obstruction to any vehicle or to the metro system or to persons using or intending to use the Metro System
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 14 and 2(2) of the Midland Metro Systems Byelaws 1999 and section 49 of the Midland Metro Act 1989.
